from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FairValueChangeIncome(BaseModel):
    """Fair value change income recorded in one company's financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company this financial data belongs to")
    value: float | None = Field(description="The fair value change income amount; None if not reported or N/A")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period for this data, e.g., '2024 Q1'")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g., 'yuan', 'RMB'")
    document_id: str | None = Field(description="Identifier of the source document")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Brief excerpt showing the metric in context")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    fair_value_change_income_list: list[FairValueChangeIncome]
